acceptanceCriteria: FactoryBot factories/traits, fixture files, seeds, test-setup HTTP endpoints (and their handlers' model writes), cy.task and Playwright setup projects are extracted into typed setup records: name, parameters, entities/attributes produced, cleanup.
Preconditions used by existing tests link to the setup records that produced them; a query 'what can produce condition C' returns candidates with evidence, or unresolved.
Overlaps V1-1891 (setup endpoints per branch) and V1-1883 (seed normalisation) are reused, not duplicated.

Mines Playwright test.extend fixtures, beforeEach/beforeAll hooks, storageState, page.route mocks and API seeding calls, plus FactoryBot; storageState contents and typed literal values are secret-screened/redacted before storage.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. Preconditions are free text today (DCP-V1-063, CCE-V0-003 hand-written fixtures); factories, seeds and test-setup endpoints are not extracted.
title: Site knowledge 3: data-setup model - precondition P <- setup S(params) + cleanup from factories, fixtures, seeds, setup endpoints and setup projects
